purpose: Expand the tail comparison from one exposed 16-row development split to query-disjoint out-of-fold predictions over all 64 adjudicated trajectories without acquiring new labels.

split.fold_0: Reuse the original 16-row development split. It is selection-exposed and may not decide adoption.
split.confirmatory_source: The original 48 training rows, partitioned before opening any fold-specific held-out metrics.
split.partition_method: Within each path_hallucinated stratum, sort by the partition key. Allocate clean rows 10/10/11 and hallucinated rows 6/6/5 to folds 1/2/3.
split.training_complement: For every fold, train on the other 48 rows in frozen original-train then original-dev source order.

limitations: The 64 labels remain Silver pipeline-pilot labels rather than independent human Gold.
Fold 0 was used to select tail_weight 0.5 and is excluded from the primary adoption gate.
Folds 1-3 use rows that participated in earlier model fitting, although their out-of-fold metrics were not used to select tail_weight.
This cross-validation closes a pipeline-selection gate; it is not a formal independent-test claim.
